title: NixOS
description: The official NixOS branding guide defines Black (#000000), White (#FFFFFF), Afghani Blue (#4D6FB7) and Argentinian Blue (#5FB8F2) alongside the accent colours Italian Violet (#AAA1F6), Indian Gold (#CBAA4B), Chinese Magenta (#D991D2), Persian Orange (#E99861), Zambian Green (#6FC488) and Norwegian Pink (#F08D94).
